purpose.zh: 问题清单、处理理由、描述统计、限制说明
purpose.en: Problem list, reasoning, descriptive statistics and limitations

standard.zh: 问题清单、处理理由、描述统计、限制说明
standard.en: Problem list, reasoning, descriptive statistics and limitations

purpose.zh: 交通分析组准备发布一份碰撞记录简报。你负责判断这张表能否支持按限速分组的描述统计，并提交一份同事能复算的质量记录。
purpose.en: A transport analysis team is preparing a collision brief. Decide whether the table can support summaries by recorded speed limit, and hand over a quality record a colleague can reproduce.

standard.zh: 质量问题清单、处理口径、分组统计和发布建议
standard.en: Issue register, treatment rules, grouped statistics and a release recommendation

title.en: AI API calls and evaluation trial

purpose.zh: 合成输入输出、评估规则、未知项
purpose.en: Synthetic inputs/outputs, evaluation rules and unknowns

standard.zh: 合成输入输出、评估规则、未知项
standard.en: Synthetic inputs/outputs, evaluation rules and unknowns

purpose.zh: 客服团队要比较两版订单助手。你负责定义通过标准，对同一批离线工单做对照，决定哪一版可以进入下一轮验证。
purpose.en: A support team is comparing two order assistants. Define the acceptance criteria, review the same offline cases for both versions and decide what can move to the next round.

standard.zh: 评测记录、严重错误清单和上线建议
standard.en: Evaluation record, critical failures and a release recommendation

purpose.zh: 线索、替代解释、授权边界
purpose.en: Signals, alternative explanations and authorization scope

standard.zh: 线索、替代解释、授权边界
standard.en: Signals, alternative explanations and authorization scope

purpose.zh: 安全运营值班收到一条远程登录告警。你需要把认证、权限和变更记录按时间对齐，判断是否升级调查，并留下接班人能继续查的事件链。
purpose.en: A security operations shift receives a remote-login alert. Align authentication, privilege and change records, decide whether to escalate and leave an evidence trail for the next shift.

standard.zh: 事件时间线、备选解释与升级交接
standard.en: Event timeline, alternative explanations and an escalation handoff

purpose.zh: 恢复步骤、回退条件、未验证项
purpose.en: Recovery steps, rollback conditions and unverified items

standard.zh: 恢复步骤、回退条件、未验证项
standard.en: Recovery steps, rollback conditions and unverified items

purpose.zh: 边缘网关的规则更新正在小流量发布。候选组出现 502 和 CPU 异常。你负责判断是否暂停、如何回退，以及什么时候可以宣告恢复。
purpose.en: A gateway rule update is being canaried. The candidate group shows 502 errors and abnormal CPU. Decide whether to pause, how to roll back and when recovery can be declared.

standard.zh: 回退决策、恢复验收记录和复盘行动
standard.en: Rollback decision, recovery acceptance and follow-up actions

purpose.zh: 为订单团队写一张退款率口径卡。订单和退款分别有时间戳，请写明所用日期、唯一订单键和观察窗口。
purpose.en: Write a refund-rate definition card. Orders and refunds each have timestamps. Specify the time basis, order key and observation window.

purpose.zh: 设计订单与明细的查询，每笔订单一行且保留无明细的订单。写出关联前的汇总步骤和行数校验。
purpose.en: Design a query with one row per order, including orders without lines. Show the pre-aggregation step and a row-count check.

purpose.zh: 用两个渠道的订单数与退款数做一张分组表和总计表。注明统计粒度、空值规则，并复算整体退款率。
purpose.en: Build channel and overall summaries from order and refund counts. State the grain and null policy and recompute the overall rate.

purpose.zh: 对金额 20、空、0、40 写一份缺失规则，分别报告记录数、有效金额数和有效均值。
purpose.en: Write a missing-value policy for amounts 20, blank, 0 and 40. Report row count, valid count and valid mean.

purpose.zh: 按订单号比较四行订单，记录重复、同键不同金额及保留理由。留下可追溯的原行号。
purpose.en: Compare four orders by ID. Log exact duplicates, conflicting amounts and the retention rationale with raw row references.

purpose.zh: 为一张订单表设计三条规则，并给每条规则写失败示例、负责人、是否影响发布及复查条件。
purpose.en: Design three rules for an orders table. Record a failure example, owner, release impact and follow-up condition for each.

purpose.zh: 给配送时间 5、6、7、8、60 分钟写两句分析。分别计算均值和中位数，并解释它们为何不同。
purpose.en: Summarize delivery times of 5, 6, 7, 8 and 60 minutes. Calculate mean and median and explain the difference.

purpose.zh: 为活跃和流失用户做满意度调查方案，写清邀请渠道、分层方式及非响应会怎样影响结果。
purpose.en: Plan a satisfaction survey for active and churned users. Specify recruitment, strata and the effect of non-response.

purpose.zh: 为新结账流程拟一个对照实验。写清如何随机、如何处理重复访问，以及什么结果仍需要更多样本。
purpose.en: Plan a checkout experiment. Describe randomization, repeated visits and when more evidence is needed.

purpose.zh: 画一个订单明细事实表和日期、商品维度，标注主键、外键以及金额在哪个粒度计算。
purpose.en: Sketch an order-line fact table with date and product dimensions. Mark keys and the grain at which revenue is computed.

purpose.zh: 在表格中填入四笔交易（华东 40、华东 60、华南 30、华南 10）。用地区做行字段，分别汇总金额和笔数，与手算核对。
purpose.en: Enter four transactions (East 40, East 60, South 30, South 10). Use region as the row field. Summarize amounts and counts, then check both by hand.

purpose.zh: 把六个月退货率做成趋势图草稿，再为四地区的同月比较选一种图。写标题、轴单位和数据说明。
purpose.en: Sketch a six-month return-rate trend and a same-month regional comparison. Write titles, units and data notes.

purpose.zh: 为配送负责人写四句简报，分别写观察、证据、限制和一个可检验的后续动作。
purpose.en: Write a four-sentence brief for delivery operations: observation, evidence, limitation and a testable follow-up.

purpose.zh: 为客服工单分流写任务卡，定一个多数类别基线和一个能反映漏分风险的指标。
purpose.en: Write a routing task card with a majority-class baseline and a metric for missed cases.

purpose.zh: 制作三行工单 CSV，包含编号 001、有效日期、空日期和一条无效日期。读取编号为字符串，保留原日期列，并统计解析失败行。
purpose.en: Make a three-row ticket CSV with ID 001 and valid, blank and invalid dates. Read IDs as strings, preserve the raw date column and count parsing failures.

purpose.zh: 为同一客户多条工单的数据画训练、验证、测试切分，并注明何处拟合标准化。
purpose.en: Design train, validation and test splits for repeat customers. Mark where scaling is fit.

purpose.zh: 记录一个分类基线与一个复杂模型在常见、稀有工单上的误差。写出一种验证假设的方法。
purpose.en: Compare a baseline and a complex classifier on frequent and rare tickets. Propose a test of an error hypothesis.

purpose.zh: 给工单提取器写 JSON 字段、示例、缺字段或非法状态时的处理。
purpose.en: Define JSON fields and examples for ticket extraction, including missing or invalid outputs.

purpose.zh: 为帮助中心写两条可回答问题和一条资料不足的问题，标出答案应引用的段落。
purpose.en: Write two answerable help-center questions and one without evidence. Identify passages each answer may cite.

purpose.zh: 为订单助手写一张权限表，分别处理查询、退款预览、正式退款以及失败重试。
purpose.en: Specify permissions for order lookup, refund preview, committing refunds and retrying failures.

purpose.zh: 为需人工复核的工单设计混淆矩阵，用一次阈值调整解释精确率与召回率的变化。
purpose.en: Create a confusion matrix for human-review tickets and explain a precision–recall trade-off from changing the threshold.

purpose.zh: 给虚构退款助手编写三个测试，明确身份条件、期望动作、严重错误和可观察证据。
purpose.en: Write three tests for a mock refund assistant, specifying identity, expected action, critical errors and observable evidence.

purpose.zh: 挑三个失败样本归类，写修复假设、复测项及一个可区分假设的对照。
purpose.en: Classify three failures, write a fix hypothesis and propose a comparison to distinguish possible causes.

purpose.zh: 做一张评测清单，使同事能复跑同一批工单并解释两次结果的差异。
purpose.en: Create an evaluation manifest so a colleague can reproduce a batch and explain differences across runs.

purpose.zh: 为工单分流器写上线监测表，指定两类分组指标、基线、阈值和应由谁核对。
purpose.en: Write a monitoring plan for a ticket router with segmented measures, baseline, threshold and review owner.

purpose.zh: 为高影响工单制定三档处理规则，给人工升级写入触发条件、所需证据与责任人。
purpose.en: Define three handling tiers for high-impact tickets, including escalation triggers, evidence and owner.

purpose.zh: 用离线记录画出客户端、DNS、反向代理与应用，标注每层能观察到的字段。
purpose.en: Sketch client, DNS, reverse proxy and application from offline records and label observable fields.

purpose.zh: 画出浏览器到网关、网关到服务的两段链路，标注哪里验证证书、哪里需要加密。
purpose.en: Draw browser-to-gateway and gateway-to-service links. Mark certificate checks and encryption needs.

purpose.zh: 为离线报名系统拟一份检查范围，列出允许数据、排除系统、复核责任和停止条件。
purpose.en: Write a testing scope for an offline sign-up system: allowed data, excluded systems, owner and stop conditions.

purpose.zh: 设计虚构门户的登录、退出、密码重置检查表，写出已注销会话再次访问时的预期。
purpose.en: Design checks for sign-in, sign-out and password reset, including requests after a session is revoked.

purpose.zh: 给模拟订单 API 写权限矩阵，覆盖本人订单、他人订单与客服只读角色。
purpose.en: Write an access matrix for a mock order API, covering owned orders, other users’ orders and a read-only support role.

purpose.zh: 为两个模拟服务列出凭据存放、访问主体、轮换顺序与旧凭据失效验证。
purpose.en: Specify storage, access, rotation order and invalidation checks for two mock services.

purpose.zh: 给四行合成登录日志统一 UTC，用会话字段关联，说明无法关联的行。
purpose.en: Normalize four synthetic login records to UTC, correlate by session and explain unmatched rows.

purpose.zh: 一段离线日志含多次失败与一次成功。列出正常维护和异常访问的分别证据。
purpose.en: Review offline failed logons followed by success. List evidence for maintenance and for suspicious access.

purpose.zh: 为模拟值班交接写事件摘要，带行号、受影响范围、待核实事项及负责人。
purpose.en: Write a mock incident handoff with row references, impact, open questions and owner.

purpose.zh: 画出模拟文件上传的浏览器、接口、处理器和存储边界，标注三项要验证的控制。
purpose.en: Map a mock upload flow and mark three controls to verify between browser, API, processor and storage.

purpose.zh: 为离线搜索接口设计普通文本、特殊字符和非法排序字段的检查。
purpose.en: Design offline search checks for ordinary text, special characters and invalid sort fields.

purpose.zh: 为订单授权修复制定允许与拒绝的用例，列明复现环境与输出证据。
purpose.en: Design allowed and denied cases for an order authorization fix and identify environment and evidence.

purpose.zh: 为离线日志处理服务列出运行账号、需要读取的目录和唯一可写位置。
purpose.en: Specify the account, readable directories and one writable location for an offline log processor.

purpose.zh: 画一次请求的链路，并记录 DNS 失败、上游不可达和应用拒绝的可观察差异。
purpose.en: Map a request and note how DNS failure, unreachable upstream and application rejection differ.

purpose.zh: 对一段 CPU、请求量和 5xx 记录建立时间线，说明还需要哪些对照。
purpose.en: Build a timeline from CPU, traffic and 5xx observations and specify a comparison.

purpose.zh: 给一个小服务拟容器构建说明，写清上下文、依赖、启动命令和运行配置。
purpose.en: Write a build outline for a small service: context, dependencies, entry command and runtime configuration.

purpose.zh: 画出启动慢的服务从发布到接收流量的过程，标注启动、就绪和存活探针。
purpose.en: Sketch rollout to traffic for a slow-starting service, labeling startup, readiness and liveness probes.

purpose.zh: 为两个环境写出配置变更的计划、审批、应用、核对与回退顺序。
purpose.en: Outline plan, approval, apply, verification and rollback for two environments.

purpose.zh: 给上传服务列一套指标，并为其中一项写触发条件和处置说明。
purpose.en: Specify upload service measures and write a trigger and response for one alert.

purpose.zh: 为搜索服务写出好请求定义、有效请求、时间窗和误差预算。
purpose.en: Define good searches, valid requests, the measurement window and error budget.

purpose.zh: 从一个模拟高延迟请求出发，写下怎样用 trace ID 关联两项服务日志。
purpose.en: For one simulated slow request, explain how to join two service logs by trace ID.

purpose.zh: 为灰度发布写检查表，明确指标、最小样本、观察时窗和停止条件。
purpose.en: Write a canary checklist with metric, minimum sample, observation window and stop condition.

purpose.zh: 写一次模拟回退的执行与验收清单，标注负责人、版本、用户路径和停止条件。
purpose.en: Write an offline rollback and verification checklist with owners, version, user path and stop conditions.

purpose.zh: 写一页故障交接和复盘，给两项改进写责任、期限和完成检查。
purpose.en: Write a one-page handoff and postmortem with two actions, owners, deadlines and verification.

purpose.zh: 写出报名页标题、表单、提交按钮和错误信息的 HTML 结构。
purpose.en: Mark up a signup page heading, form, submit control and errors.

purpose.zh: 给卡片列表设计 320 到 1440px 的列变化，并放入一条长标题验证。
purpose.en: Design a card grid from 320 to 1440px and check one long title.

purpose.zh: 为动态列表做一个删除动作，描述如何在父节点识别子按钮以及如何处理表单默认行为。
purpose.en: Implement delete for a dynamic list. Explain how the parent locates the clicked control and how form defaults are handled.

purpose.zh: 用 Tab、Shift+Tab 和 Escape 走一次设置弹窗，记录入口、循环、关闭和返回点。
purpose.en: Check a settings dialog with Tab, Shift+Tab and Escape. Log entry, cycling, dismissal and focus return.

purpose.zh: 给报名表做空值、格式错误和保存成功三种状态，检查焦点、文本和朗读。
purpose.en: Design empty, invalid and successful submission states and check focus, wording and announcements.

purpose.zh: 设计输入联想的加载、空、失败、重试和快速改词行为，写出模拟失败步骤。
purpose.en: Design loading, empty, failure, retry and rapid query changes for autocomplete. Describe how to simulate failure.

purpose.zh: 设计两列表单组件，标注父组件持有的选择、子组件 props 和局部状态。
purpose.en: Design a two-panel form. Mark the parent’s selection, child props and local state.

purpose.zh: 列出新成员从检出代码到运行构建的命令，核对锁文件不匹配时怎样处理。
purpose.en: Write steps from checkout to build and handle a lockfile mismatch.

purpose.zh: 编写一条从空表单到保存成功的测试，另外验证错误时数据未丢。
purpose.en: Write a blank-to-success form test and an error case that preserves input.

purpose.zh: 为商品详情页设计一次测量，标注主图、操作响应及首屏布局变化。
purpose.en: Plan a product-page measurement for the main image, interaction response and initial layout movement.

purpose.zh: 给用户评论页面列出文本渲染和脚本来源规则，写一个报告模式下的检查。
purpose.en: Specify text rendering and script sources for a comment page and plan a report-only check.

purpose.zh: 给注册页上线写验收表，覆盖慢网、错误、键盘与手机，并标注两个回退条件。
purpose.en: Write release checks for signup on slow networks, failures, keyboard and mobile and define rollback triggers.

purpose.zh: 为读取与创建订单写两条接口说明，补上未登录、无权限和找不到记录时的行为。
purpose.en: Specify read and create endpoints and behavior for unauthenticated, forbidden and missing resources.

purpose.zh: 为订单查询写一个 OpenAPI 片段，分别声明成功、缺失对象和校验失败的结构。
purpose.en: Write an OpenAPI fragment for order lookup with success, missing object and validation-error schemas.

purpose.zh: 写出创建订单的请求对象、控制器、服务和数据接口骨架。分别测试数量无效与库存不足，并确认拒绝时没有新增订单。
purpose.en: Sketch a request object, controller, service and data interface for order creation. Test invalid quantity and insufficient stock and verify neither failure inserts an order.

purpose.zh: 画待付款、已付款、已取消的状态表，写清并发支付和取消时的检查及冲突结果。
purpose.en: Map pending, paid and canceled order states and define how concurrent payment and cancel conflict.

purpose.zh: 设计订单、明细和商品三张表的主外键、数量范围和唯一性。
purpose.en: Design keys, quantity bounds and uniqueness for orders, lines and products.

purpose.zh: 画库存扣减与订单落库的事务，写中途出错和最后一件商品并发购买的检查。
purpose.en: Plan a transaction for stock and order writes. Check mid-flight errors and concurrent purchase of the last item.

purpose.zh: 比较按订单号查一行和按大范围日期查多行的计划，解释各自访问路径。
purpose.en: Compare plans for one order ID and for a wide date range and explain access methods.

purpose.zh: 给模拟 API 写过期、登出、重新登录三种会话检查。
purpose.en: Specify expired, signed-out and newly signed-in session checks for a mock API.

purpose.zh: 为读取和取消订单写权限矩阵，覆盖归属和客服只读。
purpose.en: Write a permission matrix for order reading and cancellation, including owner and read-only support.

purpose.zh: 为按名称查询接口写允许字段、边界和参数绑定示例，定义对非法筛选的响应。
purpose.en: Specify allowed filters and bounds, parameter binding and error behavior for a name-search endpoint.

purpose.zh: 为创建订单写成功、非法输入、跨账号请求和重复提交的集成检查。
purpose.en: Write integration cases for create success, invalid input, another account and replay.

purpose.zh: 为一个外部依赖定义错误类别、请求超时和总重试窗口。
purpose.en: Define error classes, request timeouts and a total retry window for a dependency.

purpose.zh: 为模拟订单 API 设计一次失败的请求 ID、日志字段和关联追踪。
purpose.en: Design a request ID, logging fields and a correlated trace for a failed order request.

purpose.zh: 建模订单明细与日汇总两个数据集，标注主键、粒度和不能直接相加的比率。
purpose.en: Model order lines and daily aggregates with keys, grains and non-additive ratios.

purpose.zh: 写一条把明细汇总为每日销售的 SQL 草稿，保留取消状态并核对来源和结果的金额。
purpose.en: Draft a daily sales transform with cancellation rules and source-to-output amount reconciliation.

purpose.zh: 为按日读取事件表选择分区，并写新增可选字段时的新旧读取预期。
purpose.en: Choose a partition for an events table queried by day, and specify old/new behavior for a new optional field.

purpose.zh: 画订单日汇总 DAG，标注数据日、依赖、重跑参数和输出分区。
purpose.en: Draw a daily order DAG with data date, upstream dependencies, rerun parameters and output partition.

purpose.zh: 为日汇总设计写入策略，写出中途失败再重跑后的行数和金额预期。
purpose.en: Design daily output writes and expected counts and amounts after a partial failure and rerun.

purpose.zh: 为三个漏跑日期拟补数顺序，列出影响下游、资源上限与验证。
purpose.en: Plan a backfill of three missed dates with downstream effects, resource limits and checks.

purpose.zh: 为 5 分钟订单统计写事件时间窗口，示例说明迟到两分钟和十分钟的处理。
purpose.en: Define five-minute event-time windows and handling for events two or ten minutes late.

purpose.zh: 给模拟支付事件写去重键、保留期限和中断重放验收。
purpose.en: Define a dedupe key, retention period and interruption/replay check for payment events.

purpose.zh: 为晚到订单写一项增量核对，说明哪些分区需要更正和如何与全量对照。
purpose.en: Write a late-order check with affected partitions and a full recomputation comparison.

purpose.zh: 为事件 ID、客户键和有效金额编写测试清单，给每项规则定失败处理。
purpose.en: Write checks for event ID, customer key and amount, with failure handling for each.

purpose.zh: 为来源订单、日汇总和仪表板绘制血缘，标注哪次运行和哪些下游受变更影响。
purpose.en: Draw lineage for source orders, daily aggregates and a dashboard. Mark a run and consumers affected by change.

purpose.zh: 给仪表板上游写延迟告警和停止发布条件，补上补数后验收和通知对象。
purpose.en: Write a freshness alert and release-stop rule, with backfill validation and a communication owner.

purpose.zh: 把一个退货需求改写为三个验收条件，标注每条用例对应的需求。
purpose.en: Write three acceptance criteria for a return rule and map each test to its requirement.

purpose.zh: 列出登录、支付和帮助文档的失效风险，说明先测哪个以及为什么。
purpose.en: List sign-in, payment and help-page risks and explain the test order.

purpose.zh: 为购物车写一份策略，分配价格计算、支付接口和用户端结账验证。
purpose.en: Plan cart checks for price calculation, payment integration and checkout as a user.

purpose.zh: 给 1–10 的购买数量写有效、无效类，并列出最低和最高值附近的输入。
purpose.en: Design partitions and boundary checks for quantities 1–10 inclusive.

purpose.zh: 为会员和订单金额两条件的运费规则写决策表，每条可行规则安排用例。
purpose.en: Build a shipping-fee decision table for membership and order amount and test feasible rules.

purpose.zh: 为待付款、已支付、已取消写状态图和一次重复支付的用例。
purpose.en: Sketch pending, paid and canceled states and test a repeated payment.

purpose.zh: 给购物车写一个探索主题，覆盖异常刷新和多标签操作，记下观察和未知。
purpose.en: Write a cart exploration charter for refresh and multi-tab behavior, with observations and unknowns.

purpose.zh: 为偶发重复提交写缺陷单，写明用户环境、网络状态、频率和最短步骤。
purpose.en: File a report for intermittent double submission with environment, network, frequency and minimal steps.

purpose.zh: 为退款页的修复写原缺陷复测，以及同模块两项回归用例。
purpose.en: Plan a refund fix confirmation plus two impacted regression cases.

purpose.zh: 设计三个并行的购物车用例，每条都有独立用户和初始化方法。
purpose.en: Design three parallel cart cases, each with an independent user and setup.

purpose.zh: 用按钮名称和可见成功提示写一条结账检查，考虑慢网络和返回错误。
purpose.en: Write a checkout check using control names and visible confirmation, including slow and failed responses.

purpose.zh: 设计拉取请求检查，写执行条件、失败时保留的日志和合并门槛。
purpose.en: Design pull-request checks with triggers, failure artifacts and merge criteria.

purpose.zh: 为任务导入工具写需求，覆盖重复标题、空行、错误与成功结果。
purpose.en: Specify a task importer including duplicate titles, blank rows, errors and success.

purpose.zh: 把清单工具拆成两个可使用切片，为每个切片写最小验收。
purpose.en: Split a task-list tool into two usable slices and write minimum acceptance checks.

purpose.zh: 将读文件、解析、业务规则和写结果拆分，解释改变文件格式时应改哪部分。
purpose.en: Separate reading, parsing, business rules and writing. Explain what changes when the input format changes.

purpose.zh: 实现一段计算购物券金额的纯函数，列出负值、零值和有效值的行为。
purpose.en: Implement a pure voucher calculation and specify negative, zero and valid inputs.

purpose.zh: 为重复编号检测比较嵌套扫描与集合方案，描述时间及额外空间。
purpose.en: Compare nested scanning and a set for duplicate IDs, including time and extra space.

purpose.zh: 为文件导入写空文件、非法行和读取失败的预期结果，并说明何时停止。
purpose.en: Specify blank file, malformed row and read-failure behavior, including when to stop.

purpose.zh: 为数量折扣编写三项断言，覆盖刚好达标和差一项。
purpose.en: Write three assertions for a quantity discount, including exactly at threshold and one below.

purpose.zh: 把一次仅在空输入触发的错误写成最小复现和一个对照。
purpose.en: Create a minimal reproduction for an empty-input failure and one control.

purpose.zh: 为两个重复方法写重构计划，先记录对外行为，再提取共有逻辑并验证。
purpose.en: Plan a refactor of duplicate methods, documenting behavior before extracting shared logic.

purpose.zh: 在本地创建演练仓库，模拟两条分支改同一文件，记录冲突解决和验证。
purpose.en: In a local exercise repo, make competing branch changes and record conflict resolution and checks.

purpose.zh: 对一份小改动写两条评审意见，一条覆盖缺失边界，一条说明已有验证。
purpose.en: Review a small change with a missing boundary check and one verified behavior.

purpose.zh: 为一次小工具发布写版本记录，列出修复、受影响用例和已知限制。
purpose.en: Write release notes for a small tool with fixes, affected flows and known limitations.

purpose.zh: 为客服登记流程写现状和目标草图，列出一个暂未核对的例外。
purpose.en: Sketch current and target support intake workflows with an unverified exception.

purpose.zh: 为一次离线工单系统上线列出交付与排除范围，并为一项需求写验收用例。
purpose.en: Define included and excluded scope for an offline ticket launch and write an acceptance case.

purpose.zh: 列出账号、数据和验收三个依赖，分别写主责、何时确认和失败时上报对象。
purpose.en: List account, data and acceptance dependencies with owners, verification and escalation.

purpose.zh: 为模拟工单系统写配置清单，区分演练和上线时的变更与核对。
purpose.en: Write a configuration checklist separating rehearsal and production checks.

purpose.zh: 为一线客服、主管和审计写最小权限矩阵，补上权限不足的用例。
purpose.en: Write a least-privilege matrix for support, supervisors and audit, including denied cases.

purpose.zh: 为旧工单迁移制定字段映射、失败处理和切换前后对账表。
purpose.en: Prepare field mapping, failure handling and reconciliation for ticket migration.

purpose.zh: 设计工单创建、流转和关闭三条验收用例，写明角色和所需证据。
purpose.en: Design acceptance cases for ticket creation, routing and closure with roles and evidence.

purpose.zh: 为两小时窗口写模拟切换清单，指定第一轮试迁何时完成以及通知对象。
purpose.en: Plan a two-hour simulated cutover with a trial migration checkpoint and communication owners.

purpose.zh: 写一张上线决策卡，列必需通过的用例、回退阈值及原服务恢复条件。
purpose.en: Write a go/no-go card with required tests, rollback triggers and criteria for the previous service.

purpose.zh: 为一线与主管各写一个真实感的练习，说明练习成功怎样观察。
purpose.en: Write one realistic exercise each for agents and supervisors with observable success.

purpose.zh: 把“系统登录不了”整理为一次支持记录，写要询问的信息和升级条件。
purpose.en: Turn “sign-in is broken” into a support record with evidence questions and escalation triggers.

purpose.zh: 写一个交接清单，覆盖验收材料、运行手册、已知问题、支持渠道和复查日期。
purpose.en: Write a handoff checklist with acceptance evidence, runbook, known issues, support channels and next review.
